name: Osananajimi Childhood Love
original_name: おさななじみ Childhood Love
source:
Honoka, the sweet and clingy heroine, has always been close to her older brother figure, Kai.
One night, she visits Kai, who is busy preparing for his university entrance exams. Despite being brushed off due to his study commitments, Honoka is determined to get his attention. As the story unfolds, glimpses of their shared past and moments that test their bond as childhood friends are revealed, filled with heart-fluttering scenes.

[Edited from [url=https://hase-im-haus.itch.io/childhood-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
甜美又粘人的女主角穗香，一直与她的哥哥凯伊关系密切。
一天晚上，她拜访了正在忙着准备大学入学考试的凯。尽管因学业而被拒绝，穗香决心引起他的注意。随着故事的展开，他们共同的过去和考验他们作为儿时好友的纽带的时刻一一浮现，充满了令人心潮澎湃的场景。

[编辑自[url=https://hase-im-haus.itch.io/childhood-love]itch.io[/url]]
